# @ashenjyy/dsh-subagent-antigravity
English | 中文
Download · Documentation · Changelog · Contributing
## Summary
Run delegated text tasks in **Google Antigravity ACP Server 1.4.3** from DeepSeek Harness. Each task
starts a fresh native process and session. Antigravity handles reasoning and tools; DSH manages del
egation, cancellation, and result delivery.
The architecture follows the official Codex subagent provider. This is a community integration. It u
ses the ACP Server directly and requires neither the `agy` CLI nor the Antigravity App.
| Requirement | Supported |

| Platform | Windows x64 |
| DeepSeek Harness | `0.2.1` from rc.3, and `0.2.2` from rc.1; subsequent

RCs and stable releases within these series |
| Native runtime | ACP Server 1.4.3 and its matching

harness, included in the release TGZ |
| Host dependencies | DSH packages, Cordis, and Schemastery s

upplied by the host/Profile |
| Model and effort | Native defaults or explicit ACP-supported values;
unrestricted by default, no fallback |
The compatibility range is `>=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.2.2-0 || >=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.2.3-0`. The latest source revie
w and compilation cover Harness `0.2.2-rc.1`, Cordis 4.1.0, and Schemastery 3.19.0. Each supported s
eries admits subsequent RCs and its stable release without individual registration; 0.2.3 is exclude
d. This policy does not claim future releases were exercised. See the compatibility record.

## Use this package
### Installing the Bundle
Download **`ashenjyy-dsh-subagent-antigravity-0.2.4-win32-x64.tgz`** from v0.2.4. Choose the release
TGZ, not GitHub's source-code archive. Install it through DSH's Plugins page or the CLI for your Pr
not GitHub's source-code archive. Install it through DSH's Plugins page or the CLI for your Profile:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The TGZ already contains both native executables and their integrity record. Leave `runtimeDir` unse
t; no separate runtime installation or download is needed. The host must supply a compatible depende
ncy set. Restart DSH if prompted.
### Authentication
**Installation does not open a login page. Configure authentication before the first task.** The def
ault `native` uses ACP's saved selection and enterprise policy; it does not automatically select per
sonal-account login. App or `agy` login is not guaranteed to carry over.
Choose personal Google OAuth, Gemini Enterprise OAuth, Gemini API key, Agent Platform ADC/Express, a
n enterprise gateway, or existing native configuration. Account and administrator policy determine a
gateway, or existing native configuration. Account and administrator policy determine availability.
See the **authentication guide** for Windows login commands, provider settings, and ADC path trouble
shooting. Upgrading from 0.1.0 while keeping its ADC route requires `authMethod: agent-platform` and
`agentPlatformMode: adc`.
### Configuration
Set provider fields in DSH's plugin settings or your Profile patch. `model` and `effort` are optiona
l; explicit values must be advertised by ACP and confirmed after selection. Unsupported settings fai
l without selecting another model.
Tool permission defaults to `deny`. Use `allow-once` when this provider should approve supported ord
inary tool operations. See the configuration reference for every field and permission boundary.
### Exposing the tool
The bundle registers the provider and global **`subagent_antigravity`** tool automatically. The bund
le wiring documents the two entries and `maxDepth: provider-managed`.
### What you get
The parent receives a child ID after native startup and configuration, then an asynchronous completi
on containing assistant text or a failure diagnostic. Native thoughts, tool transcripts, raw protoco
l data, and credentials are not copied into the parent answer.
### Failure and recovery
Missing runtime files, authentication failures, and unsupported model settings fail explicitly. Ther
e is no automatic task retry, model substitution, CLI fallback, or rollback of completed side effect
s. For session or credential errors, start with Windows troubleshooting.
## Understand the implementation
The architecture guide covers source responsibilities, ACP startup, result handling, cancellation, a
nd performance. Runtime integrity caching, concurrent-check coalescing, stream backpressure, and bou
nded output reduce adapter overhead while preserving one native process per task.

## Model experience
Give the child a self-contained text task and working directory. It uses Antigravity's own context a
nd tools; it does not inherit the parent conversation or receive DSH tools. See child requests and r
s; it does not inherit the parent conversation or receive DSH tools. See child requests and results.
## Known limitations and deferred work
One text prompt per session; no resume, task-question UI, automatic retry, or execution deadline bey
ond startup. Native sessions can persist. App-only plugins are not automatically inherited, and OAut
h can require interaction. Full boundaries and verification limits are in the architecture guide.
